title: UMCP Operating System: Functional Ground, Formal Protocol, and Diagnostic Atlas

tier_0: Active evaluation grammar: a declared object becomes an accountable evaluation through frozen contract, admitted bounded trace, fixed kernel outputs, declared closures, return and seam accounting, ledger reconciliation, derived stance, and an audit record.

Diagnostic-atlas placement discipline: established mathematical structures may enter as degenerate limits, boundary regimes, projections, diagnostic surfaces, or reference limits only when contract, trace reduction, surviving invariant, closure condition, boundary behavior, and return/seam status are explicit.

source_role: Evaluation / contract / closure / return / seam / ledger / stance source; UMCP is a functional system, not Tier-0 itself (handoff manifest).
scope: The contract-first operating system for evaluable structure inside Structura Reditus, as source-of-truth reference and practical protocol.
non_goal: UMCP is not a general container for theory, not a loose collection of mathematical correspondences, not the object, not the whole field, and not the whole theory; diagnostic regimes are not stance, and extensions do not become authority without admission.
notes: Shared packet DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21212668 (coordinated four-paper release); the DOI identifies the archive, the record identifies the member work. The Tier-0 burden listed is the protocol grammar this source specifies; the functional system itself is not an authority tier.
